name: spherity-research
description: Build and quality tooling for the Spherity Research GitHub Pages portal.

scripts.build: pnpm run atlas:prepare && bundle exec jekyll build --source docs --destination _site && pnpm run pdf-shares
scripts.social-cards: pnpm run atlas:prepare && node scripts/generate-dpp-paper-map.mjs && node scripts/generate-social-cards.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm run atlas:prepare && bundle exec jekyll serve --source docs --livereload
scripts.check: pnpm run pdf-shares:test && node --test scripts/test-figure-rights.mjs scripts/test-citation-metadata.mjs scripts/test-image-metadata.mjs && node scripts/validate-site.mjs --site-dir _site && pnpm run social-cards:check && pnpm run atlas:test
scripts.test: pnpm run social-cards && pnpm run build && pnpm run sitemap && pnpm run optimize && pnpm run check
scripts.test:preview: pnpm run social-cards && pnpm run build:preview && pnpm run sitemap && pnpm run optimize && pnpm run check
scripts.check:atlas-preview: pnpm run pdf-shares:test && node --test scripts/test-figure-rights.mjs scripts/test-citation-metadata.mjs scripts/test-image-metadata.mjs && node scripts/validate-site.mjs --site-dir _site --allow-drafts && pnpm run social-cards:check && pnpm run atlas:test
scripts.test:atlas-preview: pnpm run social-cards && pnpm run build:preview && pnpm run sitemap && pnpm run optimize && pnpm run check:atlas-preview
